spec: ES module exporting class `TtlCache`. Constructor: `new TtlCache({ maxSize, ttlMs, now })` where `now` is an optional clock function returning milliseconds (default `Date.now`); always read time through it. Methods: `set(key, value)`, `get(key)` (value or undefined), `has(key)` (boolean), `delete(key)` (boolean: whether it existed), getter `size` (number of live entries). An entry expires `ttlMs` after it was last SET (reading does not extend its life).
properties: set then get returns the value; has is true; unknown keys give undefined / false
an entry whose age is >= ttlMs is gone: get gives undefined, has gives false, and it is not counted in size
get does not extend an entry's lifetime, but set on an existing key resets its lifetime and value
when a set would make more than maxSize live entries, the least recently USED live entry (by get or set) is evicted
delete removes an entry and returns true, or returns false if it was absent or expired
constructor throws a RangeError unless maxSize and ttlMs are positive integers
